children: Italy's competition authority said on Tuesday it had opened an investigation into the bid by Intesa Sanpaolo
, Italy's largest bank, to take over smaller peer Monte dei Paschi di Siena
The antitrust body said its probe was aimed at verifying possible effects of the bid "on competition dynamics in numerous banking and insurance markets at the local and national level."
